annotations.title: Which keyboard sizes have a key

description: Check which keyboard sizes have a key or key group, e.g. "Delete", "F5", "Insert", "Print Screen", "backtick", "arrow keys", "numpad", "function keys". Returns, for each standard size from 100% to 60%, whether it has the key: yes, partly (how many keys of the group) or no. Sizes without it usually reach it through an Fn layer.

iso.description: Use the ISO layout (UK/EU, tall Enter, extra key by left Shift). Default ANSI.

key.description: The key or key group to look up, named the way people usually call it: Delete, F12, Home, arrow keys, numpad.

name: which_sizes_have_key

key.description: The key or key group that was looked up

present.description: How many of the keys this size has
